meaning:
πρύμνα, -ης, ἡ
prop. fem. of adj. πρύμνο, -η, -ον, (sc. ναῦς), the hindmost part of a ship, the stern: Mrk.4:38, Act.27:29; opposite to πρῷρα, Act.27:41.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: the hinder part of the ship

elsewhere.note: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion, and they woke him up, and told him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.
